subject: Air freight quote: HAM to SGN
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from HAM to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-24, and we will deliver it to Hamburg airport (HAM) ourselves.

The shipment consists of 3 pieces of printed marketing material, with a gross weight of 1413.17 lb and a total volume of 95.00 cubic feet.

Please let me know the all-in price in EUR and the earliest possible arrival at SGN.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
